purpose: Prevent further paid, instruction-only whole-scene regeneration for cases failing twice on real facility geometry.

cases.observed_result: R1: static stretching and altered gym; R2: dynamic motion improves but original gym geometry still broadened, rack/bench shifts.
cases.diagnosis: Reference-image-guided image_generation redraws a whole scene; the source is not a pixel-locked background. Stronger prompts alone did not preserve gym geometry.
hold_release_requirements: Implement or demonstrate a source-locked composition or masked edit that cannot relocate original rack, bench, window, walls, floor and ceiling
Pass independent source/scene geometry QC with unchanged source SHA
Document new isolated trial asset version and cost cap in tests before re-enabling
